🐨 Instagram @jiw0.0ny
Hello, Earth Expedition members. This is Jiwon (๑•̀ᴗ-)
Today, I'm here with Part 2 of my Western US road trip! 🚘

The Western US, in particular, is incredibly difficult to travel without a car.

앞으로 제 채널의 쇼츠 탭과 인스타 릴스 탭도 많관부입니다 💛
